zh: 怀特霍斯（加拿大西北部育空地区的首府，位于阿拉斯加高速公路旁，是铜矿开采中心和毛皮中心产区）
en: the capital of the Yukon Territory in north-western Canada. Situated on the Alaska Highway, it is the centre of a copper-mining and fur-trapping region.

头发的深色增强了皮肤的白度。

他把那块木头削成了一个简易的玩具。

通货膨胀稳步减少了他们的积蓄。

我最后总算把名单上的名字减少到了只有五个。

一颗子弹嗖的一声从我耳边飞过。

zh: 神童；有为青年

w: Who Wants to be a Millionaire?
zh: a television game show which was first shown in Britain in 1998, presented by Chris Tarrant until 2014. It has since been produced in different versions in many countries around the world. Contestants have to answer a series of general knowledge questions, for which they are given four possible answers, and, if they answer all the questions correctly, they can become a millionaire. In 2018, after a four-year break, the show returned to British television with Jeremy Clarkson as presenter.

zh: the best-known play (1962) by the US writer Edward Albee. It is about a college teacher and his wife who constantly argue and play cruel games with each other and a younger couple who visit them. In the film version (1966) the older couple were played by Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton.
